about: Is the JPL-predicted asteroid 1354 Botha visible in the Asteroids page example SPHEREx images? Measured by tools/botha_check.mjs (AI-written, Claude, Anthropic, for team Proper Motion).

method.ephemeris: JPL Horizons, astrometric RA/Dec of 1354 seen from SPHEREx (500@-163182) at each image's MJD-AVG (UTC)
method.noise: robust scatter of the sky ring (snr); the pipeline VARIANCE layer as a cross-check (snrVariance)
method.rule: a dot is there when S/N >= 5 and the brightest pixel's centroid is within 1 px of the prediction
method.verdictRule: seen: at least 7 visit images measured, all but at most one pass the rule, and no control image passes it

chance.note: random sky places in the same visit images: perImageRate = share of single measurements that pass the rule; steadyRate = share of places that pass in all but at most one image (a star would)
